elder.songTitle: Is He Worthy / Agnus Dei / We Fall Down
elder.line: We cry holy, holy, holy (We join with angels and elders)
stanza: The greatness of His mercy and love
And we cry holy, holy, holy
We cry holy, holy, holy (We join with angels and elders)
We cry holy, holy, holy (Is the Lamb)

elder.linePrev: I lay down in the garden with the spirits
